description: This Java source file defines an internal class 'ModifyAttributeStrategy' which handles 'ModifyAttribute' commands within a larger system. It manages updating or creating attributes on 'Thing' entities, including size validation and event generation for attribute modifications. The class extends a base strategy and implements specific logic for attribute change handling, event creation, and entity tagging.

classes.name: ModifyAttributeStrategy
classes.description: Implements the strategy for handling 'ModifyAttribute' commands, including attribute modification or creation, event creation, size validation, and entity tagging.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the modification or creation of an attribute on a Thing, with size validation and event generation.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Generates the result and event for modifying an existing attribute.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Generates the result and event for creating a new attribute.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the previous entity tag for the attribute if it exists.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next entity tag based on the new attribute value.
